Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro last week — Acme's security and procurement teams want to schedule a focused walkthrough on Redwood's security posture and contracts before we move to a pilot. Specifically we'd like to cover:
- SOC 2 scope and most recent report summary
- Penetration test results / process and whether a report can be shared
- DPA / data handling terms and any redlines we should be aware of

Our preferred timeline is next week (Mar 2–6). Can you and your security lead do a 45-minute call to cover the above? Our security lead (cc'd) is Kyle; procurement may join depending on outcomes.

Priority: high — procurement is asking for these items to complete the risk review.

Thanks,

Hi Jordan — Monica from Redwood Security here. Thanks for flagging availability. Thu Mar 5 10:30–11:15 PST should be fine for me; if you prefer 13:00–13:45 that also works.

Pen test: we run annual third-party pen tests and summarize findings in our SOC 2 + an internal remediation tracker. We can provide a high-level executive summary (severity categories, remediation status) ahead of the call. The full raw report is available under NDA — happy to arrange that if Acme requires it.

I’ve uploaded the executive summary and a short pen-test FAQ to our shared drive here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSOC2. If you can share any specific scope questions we’ll prep answers for the call.

On the DPA redline, I’ll ask our contracts lead to do an initial read and get back to you today — happy to flag anything material before the call.

Thanks,

Security Lead, Redwood Inference
